experiments.title: 30-degree incline, movable pulley and hanging mass
experiments.description: Left anchor S1 passes around massless moving pulley C and attaches to block A. Rope S2 attaches to C's axle, passes over fixed top wheel and ends at hanging block B. Native gravity and MSL lossless transmissions generate motion. 30 degrees is shown; masses 2/3 kg and frictionless guides are labeled illustrative assumptions.
